# Khohar Muhamad Fatahurrohman

Personal website: https://khoharrohman.my.id/

Khohar is a writer and Director at PT Aigarn Akademi Artificial. His stated interests include constitutional law, technological developments, and social and cultural affairs. The site contains a personal profile, fiction, education, and organizational experience. No articles or legal study notes are currently published in this local version.

These serialized works are linked from the site's fiction section.
